notes: This traceability record links a bounded sample C++ federate application to IEEE 1516.1-2025 §4.11. The application records its intended federation execution name, passes that exact name to Join Federation Execution, and public observers verify that the joined name-to-handle mapping is present in the selected execution and absent from a decoy execution. This tests the sample application's explicit selection and the public membership result; it does not claim that the RTI observes subjective caller intent.
